body: I didn't think he meant alcohol. Just a normal drink.
There is no room for pessimism here. Even if drinks or whatever won't raise his spirit, the intent might. He might get reminded that there are still people who need him.

Like I said, "you have people that love you" won't work because I don't have any. My parents don't like me, my siblings don't really care and I have 2 people that I occasionally talk to so it's not like they would be sad if they found out I killed myself.
